chunks: Muhammad b. Ali Majiluwayh (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi al-Qasim narrated to me. He said: Muhammad b. Ali al-Kufi narrated to me from al-Mufaddal b. Salih al-Asadi from Muhammad b. Marwan from Abu Abdillah al-Sadiq from his father from his forefathers (peace be upon them). He said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said:

Whoever hates us, the Ahl al-Bayt, Allah will raise him on the Day of Resurrection as a Jew. It was said: O Messenger of Allah! Even if he bears witness to the two testimonies? He said: Yes, for indeed he only upheld these two sayings so that his blood may not be shed, or so that he may pay the jizya as a subordinate. Then he said: Whoever hates us, the Ahl al-Bayt, Allah will raise him as a Jew. It was said: How then, O Messenger of Allah? He said: If he were to reach the Dajjal, he would believe in him.

key_terms.أبغضنا: Hated us (abghadana): harboring deep animosity or hatred, specifically toward the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.الدجال: The Dajjal (Anti-Christ): an eschatological figure who will appear before the Day of Judgment and lead people astray
key_terms.الشهادتين: The two testimonies (shahada-tayn): the declaration 'There is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah'

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet Muhammad say about hating the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: The Prophet (s) delivers a stern warning about the spiritual consequences of harboring hatred toward the Ahl al-Bayt. He states that such a person will be raised on the Day of Resurrection as a Jew, regardless of outward profession of faith. When questioned whether the two shahadas would protect such a person, the Prophet clarifies that outward declarations serve only as political protection, not spiritual salvation. He explains that the depth of such hatred is so fundamental that it would lead one to follow the Dajjal (Anti-Christ), drawing a parallel between deep spiritual misguidance and surface-level religious affiliation.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Ali Majiluwayh (rh) narrated to us. He said: My uncle Muhammad b. Abi’l Qasim narrated to me. He said: Muhammad b. `Ali al-Kufi narrated to me from al-Mufaddal b. Salih al-Asadi from Muhammad b. Marwan from Abi `Abdillah al-Sadiq from his father from his forefathers (as). He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said:

Whoever hates us, the Ahl al-Bayt, Allah will raise him up on the Day of Resurrection as a Jew. It was said: O Messenger of Allah! Even if he bears witness to the two testimonies? He said: Yes, for surely, he only upholds these two sayings so that his blood may not be shed, or so that he does not pay the jizya as a subordinate. Then, he said: Whoever hates us, the Ahl al-Bayt, Allah will raise him as a Jew. It was said: How, O Messenger of Allah? He said: If he came by the Dajjal, he would believe in him.
